text: Evening. My nephew, 10, has a temp of 38.9. Odd thing is he feels cold to touch - his hands and feet are icy and he's shivering a lot under the duvet, even though the thermometer says he's hot. No fit or jerking or anything like that. He's been to the toilet for a wee a couple of times this evening, normal. Wanted to let someone know what's going on and see what you advise.
